answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The comet cap is enforced at intake and thread publishes the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a velvet tag. That is 26 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
